Night Café & Bar in Ishigaki｜Cafe&Bar Adam and Eve

A Hidden Bar on Ishigaki Island

Concept

Cafe&Bar Adam and Eve is a cozy cocktail bar in Hamasakicho, Ishigaki Island. Enjoy cocktails, whisky, awamori, and Japanese sake in a relaxed, counter-focused space. Visitors and solo guests are welcome.

MORE THAN A BAR

Cocktails, a relaxed night café, darts, and food. Whether you’re here for a drink or a quiet coffee, enjoy the night your own way at Cafe&Bar Adam and Eve.

COCKTAILS & DRINKS

Enjoy signature cocktails, whisky, awamori, and other drinks in a relaxed bar atmosphere.

NIGHT CAFÉ

Take a break from the evening with coffee and café drinks in a comfortable, laid-back space.

DARTS & FOOD

Enjoy a game of darts and pair your drinks with food. There’s more than one way to spend your night.

FOOD

Whether you want a snack or something to pair with your drink, enjoy food alongside your favorite beverage.

NO COVER CHARGE. NO SERVICE FEE.

No cover charge and no service fee. Just order what you enjoy and spend your evening at your own pace.

Signature

Tropical Lemon Sour. A refreshing drink made for nights in Ishigaki.
